svg.title: s3ctl
svg.desc: S3 provisioning. Provisions S3 buckets, each with its own IAM user and key scoped to that bucket alone, and plans every change first. Built in: Go. Ships as: Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and GHCR. Install: brew tap netspeedy/s3ctl, then brew install s3ctl.
svg.text: Provisions S3 buckets, each with its own IAM user and key scoped to
that bucket alone, and plans every change first.
Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and GHCR
